canonical_root_role: Local working copy; only accepted commits published to remote main are the shared accepted state.

shared_source.read_policy: Resolve remote main HEAD at each Work session start; fetch required files at that same commit SHA.
shared_source.publication_policy: Validate and make a scoped commit and normal push after each substantive authorized Codex task.

receipt_scope: Ignored local operational metadata: actual publication, connector access, app-setting verification, observed Work reads, commit SHAs, and this manifest hash. Excluded from the shared artifact set.

program.organizing_unit: end market × value-chain stage × operating archetype × geography × time
program.ownership_scope: Customer ownership/organization and adoption; separate retained robotics business-model, asset/control, and value-capture inquiry.
program.customer_entry_scope: Capital-funded AI-native operating newcos and platforms; operating-design, same-technology adoption-timing and conditional labor-capacity advantages; funding, demand, competition and build/acquire/hybrid comparisons.
program.digital_ecosystem_scope: Substantial full-value-chain digital AI evidence; multivariate analogies; direct robot/site/enterprise/R&D contributions; moving baselines and joint digital/physical scenarios.
program.physical_ecosystem_scope: Humanoid/quadruped inputs and value chains, qualified production and field scale, embodiment economics, key players and layered openness; substantial quadruped deployments and bounded drone empirical comparisons.
